text:
alex khan: Heads-up — noticed ~6% of inbound leads in HubSpot yesterday hit "unassigned" for 4+ mins during EMEA morning. Might be a round-robin assignment gap.

maria chen: Oof. Any pattern on source or enrichment step?

sam patel: Quick skim of logs shows a few webhook timeouts from hs-enrich service at 08:03–08:10 UTC. If enrichment blocks assignment we fallback to unassigned.

jen obrien: Is the fallback owner configured? We used to have ops_inbound as a safety net.

alex khan: Looks like fallback_owner was unset for the new routing rule we shipped last week. That would explain it.

sam patel: Also the enrichment TTL is 10s in config but the hs webhook retry pattern is 20s, so assignment wait > TTL -> race.

maria chen: Can we patch to: set fallback_owner and shorten RR wait to 5s for EMEA? We want to keep SLA <= 60s to first owner claim.

jen obrien: Agree. Proposed patch (quick):
```yaml
hubspot.assignment:
  rr_wait: 5s
  fallback_owner: ops_inbound
  enrichment_ttl: 8s
```

sam patel: I'll validate locally against the replay dataset. If enrichment fails, we still mark for async enrichment but assign immediately.

alex khan: Thanks. Can someone add a short playbook entry for on-call? We should have checklist for triage: 1) check hs webhook health, 2) confirm fallback owner, 3) restart enrich service if error rate > 1%.

jen obrien: Added a brief snippet to the runbook and created MARK-421 for the config change.

ops-bot: MARK-421 created by jen obrien — "Set fallback owner + shorten rr_wait for EMEA inbound" (priority: P3).

maria chen: Can we also add an alert when unassigned rate > 2% for 15m? That would catch regressions before marketing ops notices.

sam patel: Yup. I’ll add a Grafana alert and a HubSpot heartbeat probe. Quick healthcheck curl we can use:
```bash
curl -fsS https://internal.leads/health || echo "lead-service-down"
```

alex khan: Perfect. Timeline? small patch + alert today, full config rollout tomorrow.

jen obrien: Scheduling deploy window 18:00 UTC today, will notify sales ops channel pre-deploy. :thumbsup:

maria chen: Thanks team — will monitor inbound metrics after deploy and report back in this thread.

alex khan: Appreciate it — this should cut down handoff jitter and reduce unassigned spikes.
